faqs.q: Are my audio files uploaded to any server?
faqs.a: Never. AudioCutter runs entirely inside your web browser using the HTML5 File API, Wavesurfer.js, and FFmpeg.wasm. Your private recordings and music files never leave your computer or phone.

faqs.q: Which audio formats can I trim and export?
faqs.a: You can load MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, and AAC files, and export your trimmed clip directly as a high-quality MP3 or uncompressed WAV file.

faqs.q: How do I make precise cuts on mobile or desktop?
faqs.a: You can drag the start and end handles directly on the waveform, use the zoom controls to inspect transients, or type exact timestamps down to the hundredth of a second in the Cut From and To fields.
